description:
With the background of Hahoe Village, the hidden romance of the gods and swordsmen conveyed by Park Sang-hee's writer of <[Palace](https://www.mangaupdates.com/series/7d5g270)>.

This webtoon is about the legends and fables from Gyeongsangbuk-do  
It is a work produced by the support of Gyeongsangbuk-do Cultural Contents Agency and the reinterpretation of the artist Park Sohee.
